title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1355 North Meridian Road in Harristown, Illinois, as the "Logan S. Palmer Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1355 North Meridian Road in Harristown, Illinois, as the "Logan S. Palmer Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office in Harristown, Illinois, after Logan S. Palmer.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1355 North Meridian Road in Harristown, Illinois, as the "Logan S. Palmer Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal service, hours, mail rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018.
